# Renato Ribeiro · renat0.mov

> Renato Ribeiro is a live director, camera operator, cinematographer and colorist based in
> Aveiro, Portugal. He also builds websites and custom apps. The site is a single page in
> English.

Contact: renatoabrribeiro@gmail.com · Instagram @renat0.mov (https://www.instagram.com/renat0.mov/)

## About

He has been around concerts since he was a kid, studied multimedia and communication at
university, and found his passion for multicamera live productions.

## Work shown on the site

- Jogo Limpo: a 31-second teaser he made, hosted on the site at
  https://renat0.mov/media/jogo-limpo-teaser.mp4
- Audioglobo: the website he built for Audioglobo, a sound and lighting company for live
  shows. https://audioglobo.pt
- Kapittal-os: a custom app he built. A short silent showcase video is at
  https://renat0.mov/media/kapittal-os.mp4

## Notes

Renato Ribeiro is Portuguese and works almost entirely in Portugal. He is not the
Brazilian philosopher, the footballer, or any of the other people of that name.
